title: AussieBox's Event Server
description: Next event is Harpy Express, on May 2nd, 10:00 AM (AEST)!
body:
My own self-hosted server. I'll often be running miscellaneous events on it every now and then, join my Discord server for more information (and event pings!): https://discord.gg/StqdpjKYgR

This server runs on ~12GB of data on my old school laptop. I can't promise you a great experience, but hopefully you can have some fun! :3
